Name: Super Massive Greenhouse
Author: sameerxxe
Description:
[font=Verdana][b][size=5][u]Super Massive Greenhouse[/u]
[/size][/b][/font][size=5][size=3][i][font=Verdana][size=4]A place for all your crops, all year long. [/size][/font][/i]

[font=Verdana]Everyone wants a big greenhouse for growing ancient fruits and starfruits all year long. But what would be the point of having all these crops if you spend the entire day just to walk across the greenhouse. Introducing warps to help speed up travel.
Each of the four corners and the center of the map have a set a warp points to help you travel between them. The warp system is rudimentary and each magic book that teleports you is located relative to the destination's position in the greenhouse.
And how about a nice refreshing bath after a hard day of work? You got it. Your very own spa. Right there in your greenhouse. Enjoy the scenery outside while you take a dip and recover your energy.
The greenhouse also has lots of tillable patches, 550 spots for all the fruit tree saplings you can find and 19 water troughs distributed across the map if you ever run out of water.
[/font]
[font=Verdana]
[u][b]New in 0.1.1:[/b][/u]
[/font][/size][/size][list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]Giant Crops have been enabled. ( Verified thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/EeveeLash/about-me]EeveeLash[/url]﻿ ) [/size][/font]
[/list][size=5][size=3]
Installation:
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download the zip file and unpack and paste its contents in [size=3]"[/size][size=3]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/size][size=3]"[/size]folder.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
[u]
[font=Verdana][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]IMPORTANT NOTE:
[/b][/size][/color][/font][/u][size=5][size=3][quote]Giant Crops are unable to grow in the greenhouse.[/quote]This is a line from Stardew Valley Wiki. Source: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Greenhouse#Advanced_tips]Greenhouse - Stardew Valley Wiki[/url]
[/size][/size]You cannot grow Giant Crops in the Greenhouse unless you have another mod that makes it possible. This mod does nothing to affect giant crops.

If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21778]Build More Greenhouses[/url] mod, you [b]MUST[/b] enable the compatibility option in the mod if you wish to use the warp mechanisms. As mentioned at the bottom of the Build More Greenhouses mod description page, the warps will always take you back to the original greenhouse. As of yet, I do not have a workaround for that.


Notes:
[/size][/size][list]
[*]If you use Immersive Farm, check the config for the same if you can't get the mod to work.
[/list]
